scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @greenward/web" "npm run dev --workspace @greenward/api"
scripts.dev:aws: concurrently -k -n web,api,sam -c green,blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @greenward/web" "npm run dev --workspace @greenward/api" "npm run sam:local"
scripts.sam:local: sam local start-api --template-file sam/template.yaml --region ap-south-1 --port 8788 --warm-containers lazy
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @greenward/web && npm run build --workspace @greenward/api
